question: When will I receive my redemption proceeds?
answer:
Once the NAV is finalised and your contract note has been issued; payment is usually processed within two business days. International transfers may take an additional one to two days to reach your account.

As specified in the fund's offering documents, the redemption process may take up to 30 days.

Please note that all KYC documents must be current and valid at the time of requesting a redemption. Any outdated documentation or changes to your KYC details may result in delays.
